mission_names.title: Stoop Sweep
mission_names.brief: Clear every gang tag off the rowhouse steps before sunset.

mission_names.title: Peach Run
mission_names.brief: Escort the arabber cart across town without spilling a single peach.

mission_names.title: Fry Thief Patrol
mission_names.brief: Chase the fry-stealing gulls off the pier before the lunch rush.

mission_names.title: Beehive Rescue
mission_names.brief: Find the missing hairspray before the neighborhood dance starts.

mission_names.title: Tow Zone Panic
mission_names.brief: Move six double-parked cars before the tow truck rolls in.

mission_names.title: Harbor Lights
mission_names.brief: Relight the waterfront lamps while dodging the dock crew.

mission_names.title: Mallet Mayhem
mission_names.brief: Grab the stolen mallet back from the market bullies.

mission_names.title: Pigeon Express
mission_names.brief: Deliver three secret notes by rooftop before the bell rings.

mission_names.title: Pothole Derby
mission_names.brief: Win a race down the bumpiest street in the city.

mission_names.title: Rooftop Relay
mission_names.brief: Pass the baton across five rooftops without touching the street.

mission_names.title: Market Day Melee
mission_names.brief: Protect the vendors from a gang raid at the weekend market.

mission_names.title: Night Bus Chase
mission_names.brief: Catch the last bus before it leaves your crew stranded.

mission_names.title: Crown Heist
mission_names.brief: Steal the feathered king's crown from his tower lair.

mission_names.title: Mural Mission
mission_names.brief: Repaint the block mural before the festival parade arrives.

mission_names.title: Last Call Lap
mission_names.brief: Finish one final Grand Prix lap before the lights go out.
